items.title: Tone3000 has launched a free open-source plugin that puts hundreds of thousands of NAM A2 device captures at your fingertips
items.excerpt: Tone3000 released a free, open-source plugin (standalone + VST3/AU) that opens up hundreds of thousands of community-made Neural Amp Modeler A2 captures, with a Chains feature for stacking amp, cab and IR captures. Neural amp modelling moves from niche DIY tooling to a free, library-scale tone workflow.
items.why: 뉴럴 앰프 모델링이 무료·오픈소스로 풀리면서 톤 디자인의 기본기가 바뀌는 사례. 커뮤니티가 학습시킨 캡처 수십만 개를 DAW 안에서 바로 쓰는 워크플로 전환이 명확하다.

items.title: Denon's Prime 4 G2 is a uniquely expressive DJ setup that borrows a few tricks from Akai's MPC range
items.excerpt: Denon's new all-in-one standalone system pairs velocity-sensitive MPCe pads with an eight-core processor that renders and manipulates track stems on the hardware itself, no laptop required. On-device stem separation turns AI unmixing into a live-performance primitive rather than a prep-time step.
items.why: AI 스템 분리가 랩톱을 떠나 스탠드얼론 하드웨어 안으로 들어간 순간 — DJ의 실연 설계 자체가 달라진다. 도구 릴리스이면서 크래프트 전환 훅이 있다.

items.title: Positive Grid announce the Spark Pedal
items.excerpt: Positive Grid squeezed its Spark amp platform into a stompbox with 33 amp models, 43 effects and access to 100,000+ community tones, backed by a companion app with Text to Tone — describe a phrase, song, artist or feeling and get matching tone suggestions — plus real-time Auto Chords. Prompt-driven tone design arrives as a pedal, not a plugin.
items.why: '텍스트로 톤을 설명하면 만들어준다'는 프롬프트 UX가 기타 페달 하드웨어로 내려온 사례. 음악 장비에서 AI 인터페이스가 어떻게 물리화되는지 보여준다.

items.title: Nopia Semi-Modular Harmony Generator Synthesizer Sneak Preview
items.excerpt: Developer Martin Grieco previewed Nopia, a harmony-generator instrument whose single-octave keyboard maps each key to a whole chord rather than a note, with hybrid sample/virtual-analog Keys, Bass, Arp and Pad engines feeding a master FX chain and looper. Pre-orders open via Kickstarter on 15 September from $650.
items.why: 코드·화성 보조를 알고리즘이 아니라 '건반 레이아웃 재설계'로 푸는 접근 — 음악 이론 지식의 진입장벽을 인터페이스 디자인으로 낮춘다. 하모니 어시스턴트 계열의 대안적 해법.

items.title: Eminently controllable, accessible by design, Sting is now a plug-in
items.excerpt: Sting, the algorithmic/improvisational melody and pattern generator, has left Max for Live to become a cross-platform VST3/AU/CLAP plugin with hands-on Launchpad control. It is also built accessible-by-design, with screen-reader support via VoiceOver, NVDA and OSARA.
items.why: 생성형 시퀀서를 '접근성 우선'으로 설계한 드문 사례 — 알고리즘 작곡 도구의 UI를 시각장애 사용자까지 포함해 다시 짠다. 생성 도구 디자인 윤리와 크래프트가 동시에 걸린다.

items.title: Suno Steals Artist Identities, Jason Isbell Wants to Stop It
items.excerpt: Jason Isbell is fronting a class action against Suno that sidesteps copyright and instead targets identity: the complaint alleges Suno captures and stores artists' 'voiceprints' without consent so users can generate tracks mimicking a specific singer's timbre and phrasing. It reframes AI music harm as a voice-likeness problem.
items.why: 음성 클로닝·보이스프린트 동의 문제는 보컬 작업자에게 바로 적용되는 실무 쟁점. 저작권이 아니라 '목소리 정체성'을 축으로 삼은 새 프레임이라 기존 수노 기사군과 겹치지 않는다.

items.title: Universal Audio's Topline Vocal Tune is now available for Apollo and UAD hardware
items.excerpt: Universal Audio brought Topline Vocal Tune to Apollo and UAD-2 DSP, giving ultra-low-latency pitch correction for tracking — from transparent fixes to hard-tuned pop and hip-hop effects — with automatic key and scale detection for the session. Tuning moves from post-production repair to a live monitoring decision.
items.why: 보컬 튜닝을 녹음 중 실시간으로 처리하며 키·스케일을 자동 판별 — 어시스티브 오디오가 트래킹 단계 의사결정을 바꾼다. 다만 AI 훅은 상대적으로 약해 후순위 후보.

items.headline: Initial Audio releases Difro Melody AI, a FREE AI MIDI generator
items.excerpt: Initial Audio's Difro Melody AI is a standalone neural MIDI generator for macOS and Windows that reharmonises and reimagines your own MIDI using a local Variational Autoencoder plus Transformer model. It runs fully offline on CPU or GPU; the free tier allows 50 generations a month, with a $49 Pro tier for unlimited use.

items.headline: Roland releases Melody Flip, a FREE AI-assisted songwriting plugin
items.excerpt: Roland has launched Melody Flip, a free AI-assisted songwriting tool built with Sony Computer Science Laboratories that generates melodic variations from 250+ creative palettes and can analyse a reference track to suggest matching styles. It ships with every Roland Cloud tier, including the free one, and exports MIDI for further editing in a DAW.

items.headline: AI Music Disputes Need More Than a Label: 5 Records All Artists Should Keep
items.excerpt: As streaming platforms move to label AI-generated tracks, a label alone won't settle a dispute. The piece lays out five records artists should keep as they work with AI tools: consent documentation, source files, version histories, revenue trails, and any challenges to unauthorised use.

items.headline: Acon Digital introduce Acoustica 8
items.excerpt: Acoustica 8 adds a powerful set of new assistive AI and machine-learning tools to Acon Digital's audio editing suite, aimed at restoration and mastering tasks that previously needed manual chain-building.

items.headline: Acon Digital's Acoustica 8 audio editor is the company's "most ambitious release to date"
items.excerpt: The longstanding editing and restoration suite gets a major update loaded with machine-learning-powered tools, spanning editing, mastering and repair workflows.

items.headline: Suno admits it obtained YouTube audio to train its AI – but challenges UMG and Sony's standing on the 'stream ripping' claim
items.excerpt: In its answer to UMG and Sony Music's amended complaint, Suno concedes it obtained audio from YouTube to train earlier models while disputing the labels' standing to bring a stream-ripping claim — a direct look at where the training data for the tools producers now use came from.

items.headline: As Suno Rolls Out Its New AI Models With Industry Licenses, What Does That Mean For the Music Business?
items.excerpt: Billboard reporters answer readers' most frequent questions about Suno's v6 rollout: what the licensed training set changes for creators, how artist opt-in remixing is meant to work, and what paying to download generated tracks means in practice.

items.headline: Is AI Music Going Legit? Suno Launches New Models
items.excerpt: Suno's v6 models were trained on Warner Music Group recordings, and WMG won't say whether its artists were able to opt out — the sharpest open question hanging over the first major-label-licensed music model.

items.headline: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
items.excerpt: Suno shipped three v6 variants — a steerable base model for paying users, an experimental v6-wild, and a third tier — all trained from scratch on licensed label data plus user data, retiring the earlier models the same day.

items.headline: Suno v6 AI music models launch in partnership with Warner Music, BMG, and Believe
items.excerpt: Suno's v6 suite launched globally as the company's first models built with rightsholders, and its previous models were retired the same day, according to Chief Product Officer Jack Brody.

items.headline: Suno v6: The Next Generation of AI Music Arrives – Now With Warner Music and BMG's Blessing
items.excerpt: A hands-on rundown of the three new Suno v6 models and, more usefully for producers, exactly what the new prompt-level editing tools can and can't do inside a track.

items.headline: Suno unveils upgrade developed with "music industry partners", while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.excerpt: Suno unveiled v6, developed with Warner Music, BMG and Believe — yet it is simultaneously fighting other labels and publishers in court, leaving creators with a tool whose legal footing depends on which catalogue they touch.

items.headline: Suno launches its v6 AI-music models. Here's what you need to know...
items.excerpt: A practical explainer on Suno v6 — the first generation developed with music rightsholders — covering what changes for people actually making tracks on the platform.

items.headline: The public Beta for Serato DJ 5.0 is here – these are the key new features and upgrades
items.excerpt: Serato DJ 5.0's public beta brings Lucid Beatgrids — analysis that adapts to fluctuating BPM — plus open streaming across multiple services at once, changing how DJs prep and mix unquantised material.

items.headline: Serato DJ 5.0 Delivers Lucid Beatgrids and More - Now Live in Public Beta!
items.excerpt: Serato DJ 5.0 is in public beta with flexible-analysis Lucid Beatgrids for tracks with fluctuating BPMs, open streaming across competing services, cue loops and more.

items.headline: ElevenLabs strikes first deal with a major label to launch AI-powered music platform and audio products
items.excerpt: Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs will build a licensed AI music platform plus joint AI audio products aimed at artists and songwriters — ElevenLabs' first agreement with a major label.

items.headline: Universal Music Group is collaborating with ElevenLabs on a new AI-powered creation platform
items.excerpt: The unnamed software will be built around licensed music from UMG artists who choose to participate, covering remixes, mashups, new interpretations and personalised vocal experiences.
